After hacking into the Boards Alive podcast to access the second half. I was able to answer a few questions Jeysie had

Jeysie:

Will Unity save her idol and score an autograph?  Yes, but it was a flirtatious wink, not an autograph

Will Bunker manage to avoid further mishaps and collateral damage to the surrounding area and his dignity? Nope. He might've if he didn't stick with Unity (luv u)

Will Argent end up with a new groupie sidekick? No… Kind of? Sorry. I don't know how to answer.

Will Akash survive the spiderbots taking up gardening? Unity is actually able to convince the bots to take up gardening, so she survives, but the spider-bots are still gardening

Will the poor Megalopolis workers ever actually get any work done? Afraid not. Noone was surprised.

Will there be more cheesy trash-talking and snark? No. It turns eerily devoid of fun trash-talk for the next 15 minutes. Then they start talking about how sexy Biomancer is… I'm sure it's fine. There were some "Technical difficulties" and then they resumed with normal trash-talk and silliness. I think they owe the Cult and Princess Cool a favor or two.

Inquiring minds want to know! I did too. Thanks for letting me answer these questions
